title: Priority routing matrix for private deployment requests by network risk and upgrade effort
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a structured, repeatable intake and routing matrix that scores incoming private/VPC/on-prem deployment requests by two primary axes: Network Risk (complexity of customer network, inbound/outbound constraints, proxy/egress requirements, airgap) and Upgrade Effort (number of infra changes, host OS constraints, windows vs linux support, patching cadence). The goal is to automate initial prioritization to reduce manual back-and-forth, reduce time-to-first-response, and surface clear remediation lanes for customers while preserving safety and compliance for sensitive workloads.
acceptance_criteria: Design and publish a 4-band priority matrix (P0-P3) mapping Network Risk x Upgrade Effort to recommended tracks (Fastlane / Standard / Engineering Consult / Deferred).

Implement an intake form extension that captures required probe fields (NAT topology, proxy type, outbound egress policy, allowed ports, kerberos/NTLM needs, OS images) and integrate with the scoring sheet.
Ship a Network Readiness Probe script (customer-run) and integrate automated parsing of its results into the intake spreadsheet.
Define SLA/response templates and recommended next steps per band, and add them to the PM KB and CRM workflow.
Document fallback/retry policies and a clear escalation path to Dedicated/Private engineering if matrix recommends engineering consult.
Run a pilot with 3 recently triaged customers and capture time-to-triage, customer clarity score, and number of follow-up questions reduced by at least 30%.
Add required fields and a quick summary card in the intake UI used by Solutions and Sales to show band assignment and estimated engineering weeks.
comments: 2026-02-16 - Aisha K: Drafted problem statement after reviewing ~22 intake tickets from last 6 months; noticed high variance in how networking details were provided (many missing outbound rules and proxy types).

2026-02-20 - Marco H: Pulled initial scoring heuristics — Network Risk score (0-10) and Upgrade Effort score (0-10). Proposed thresholds for bands: 0-3 low, 4-6 medium, 7-10 high. Shared XLS with ENG for feedback.

2026-02-25 - Eng feedback (ENG-22012): Recommended adding 'OS patch window' and 'airwall vendor' as explicit fields; warned that some customers will not run probes in airgapped environments — need manual alternative.

2026-03-02 - Product review: Agreed on 4-band outputs but changed labels to Fastlane / Standard / Engineering Consult / Remediation Track. Decided to require customer ARR and strategic flag to bump priority when scores are medium.
2026-03-05 - Legal & Security note: Security team requires KMS/HSM posture and evidence of network segmentation before approving Fastlane for regulated customers. Marked as security review required.
2026-03-08 - Design request: Need a compact intake summary card (150px) for Sales UI; DES- needed to pick up microcopy and icons. Added to design backlog with priority P2.

2026-03-10 - Pilot planning: Identified 3 customers with recent requests (ACME Corp, FinTrust, HealthGrid). Scheduling pilot calls and will measure reduction in clarifying questions and time-to-scope. Action: Marco to draft customer comms templates by 2026-03-15.
